title: Research Tool Matrix
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: A matrix showing which college research tools best answer which questions, from admission chances and cost to campus culture.

learningObjectives: Students will select the research tool best suited to a given question about a college and differentiate between data tools and experience tools.
prerequisites: Chapter 4: Researching and Narrowing Your College List

controls: Previous tool and Next tool buttons (narrow screens)

keyQuestions: Why is a neutral source like the College Scorecard useful even when a college's own website has the same number?
Which questions can't any data tool answer well?
How should you use student reviews that anyone can post?
commonMisconceptions: A college's own website is the best place to answer every question.
A single review tells you what a campus is like.
assessmentOpportunities: Students choose the strongest tool for five different questions and explain the difference between data tools and experience tools.
